name: Tandem stance
summary: Heel to toe on a line, hold still without stepping.
setup: Face the phone and place one foot directly in front of the other, heel touching toes. Hands free, look ahead. Hold, then swap feet.
brief: Place one foot directly in front of the other, heel touching toes. Hands free, look ahead, and hold still.
why: Facing the phone shows the trunk swaying and the pelvis tilting, so the timer runs only while you are steady.
progression: Eyes closed; walk heel to toe along a line.
regression: Feet slightly apart; fingertip on a wall.

faults.label: Stepping out
faults.tip: If you step, restart the hold — do not count the time before it.

faults.label: Waving the arms
faults.tip: Use the ankles and hips to balance; keep the hands relaxed at the sides.

faults.label: Feet not in line
faults.tip: A gap between the feet makes it a normal stance. Heel to toe on one line is the drill.

faults.label: Leaning on the wall
faults.tip: Hold something for safety, but let the ankles do the balancing.

guide.surface: Firm floor, a line on it if possible.
guide.cannotSee: Whether the heel really touches the toes.

points.t: Heel to toe on one line.
